official_definition: Once per turn, you can send out up to one "Rig Avatar Dragon" Token for every three counters you have, putting one core from your Field/"Brahama" Grandwalker Nexuses to each of them. (Max. 3 Tokens)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [True Genesis] or [True Genesis: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [True Genesis]", "give [True Genesis]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
